page.overview:
Who is Bardolph Beaumont?

Bardolph Beaumont (d. 1890) was a wizard in the 19th century who became an Inferius.

Bardolph joined the Ashwinders to protect his sister and Upper Hogsfield. He was taught Dark Arts by the Ashwinders but couldn't hide his horror when he witnessed them making Inferi, which he recorded in his diary. Convinced he was a spy, they executed Bardolph and created a new Inferius from his corpse.

His reanimated corpse was later destroyed by a Hogwarts student with spells in the 1890–1891 school year.
